title: Injectivity of machine encoding
statement: A binary-choice Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $\{0,\ldots,s\}$ is determined by the tuple consisting of $k$, $s$, its initial state, and its two transition functions. In particular, the map sending such a machine to this tuple is injective.
